headline: Executive session on attorney-client communications and pending litigation.
summary: The council will hold an executive session to discuss attorney-client communications and pending litigation. The item names City Manager Elaine Wang, Chief of Police Justin Huizenga, and John Klesch, SP&F Attorneys.
items: Executive session: discussion of attorney-client communications and pending litigation

Special Winooski City Council Meeting
l Wednesday, November 25, 2026 at 2 PM 
l Attend at City Hall: 27 W Allen Street
l Attend online: https://us06web.zoom.us/j/84364849328
l Attend by phone: 1 646 558 8656 
l Webinar ID: 843 6484 9328
Call to Order
Pledge of Allegiance
Agenda Review
Public Comment
The City of Winooski encourages public comment during City Council 
meetings. Please:
l Sit at the public comment table and speak into the microphone - do not 
comment from the audience 
l State your name and address where you live 
l Direct your comment to the City Council - staff may follow up after the 
meeting if appropriate 
l Keep your comment to 2 minutes if possible 
l If attending online: test your camera and mic before joining, use your real 
first and last name, use the raise hand function during public comment
Consent Agenda
Approval: City Council Meeting Minutes of November 17, 2026
11.17.26 CC Minutes.pdf
Proposed Executive Session
Discussion: Pursuant to 1 V.S.A. § 313(a)(1)(E) and (F), attorney-client 
communications and discussion of pending litigation.- Elaine Wang, 
City Manager, Justin Huizenga, Chief of Police, and John Klesch, SP&F 
Attorneys
